name: im-corporate-income-tax
description: Use this skill for Isle of Man income tax on companies and other corporate taxpayers for 2026/27 and accounting periods ending in it. It covers who is taxed (resident companies on worldwide income, non-resident companies on Manx income), the 0% standard rate, the 10% rate for banking business and for Manx retail business with taxable income over GBP 500,000, the 20% rate for Manx land and property and petroleum extraction, the separate 15% Domestic Top-up Tax for large groups, the loans to participators charge, withholding on payments to non-residents, the pay and file return due 12 months and 1 day after the period end, late return penalties, interest and economic substance questions. Trigger on: Isle of Man company tax, Manx corporate tax, 0% company IOM, R1C return, loans to participators, Domestic Top-up Tax Isle of Man.
